notes.title: Lumberhill - Patch 1.2 is here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33894005/2073000b584fd2b54f5cc0d8033e35e98fa049ae.jpg[/img]

Hey Lumberjacks!

How’s your chopping going today? This patch will help you continue your work in style with some new, unlockable characters that will make [i]Lumberhill[/i] even more hysterical to play! The skins will be available through a special event, but more details on that tomorrow so stay tuned!

See the full changelog below.

[h3]Changelog:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Introduced new, free, downloadable character skins that will be available through a special event.
[*] Added analytics which gathers anonymous data to quickly fix game bugs and improve the gameplay experience efficiently. 

You can expect to see a privacy policy pop up at the beginning of the game. We would like to assure you that we do not collect any personal data that allows us to recognize a player’s identity. Accepting the privacy policy only allows us to collect statistics that help us to balance and improve the game in order to produce the best possible gaming experience for our players. This data is completely anonymous.

[*] Fixed minor bugs. 
[/list]

How has your [i]Lumberhill[/i] experience been so far? We’d love to hear your thoughts in our Steam Discussions and on our Discord server. You can also contact us at [url=lumberhill.support@allingames.com.]lumberhill.support@allingames.com.[/url]

If you enjoy the game, please also consider dropping us a review. They help us out a lot!

notes.title: A New Lumberhill patch is here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33894005/d8f33ad78d3b0c60b5beeddf3fc77493d0d230c3.jpg[/img]

Hey-ho Lumberjacks!

We hope your chopping is going well! We want to make it even better for you with [i]Lumberhill[/i]’s first ever patch. One of the cool changes the patch introduces is the ability to save photos! Just head to [b]Menu > Options > Preferences and enable the option[/b]. In addition, there are several fixes to make your gaming experience smoother. See the full changelog below.

[h3]Changelog:[/h3]

[h3]New things:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Photos can now be saved. You can turn this option on in Menu > Options > Preferences.
[/list]

[h3]Features:[/h3]
[list]
[*] VSync is now enabled by default—the game won’t eat so many of your computer’s resources. You can disable it in Menu > Options for a higher frame rate;
[*] Players will no longer stack inside wells;
[*] Fixed collisions on rope bridges in Dino levels;
[*] Fixed the issue that allowed players to change skins during gameplay and thereby drop items they were holding;
[*] Players can no longer carry 2 items at once in the PvP level summary;
[*] Fixed the Steam Achievement “Collect them all!”—the player needs to unlock all stars, win all challenges, and collect 200 versus medals to get all unlockable characters;
[*] Fixed some bugs in localization for: German, Spanish-Latin America, French, Japanese, Portuguese-Brazil, Portuguese, Russian, Chinese (Simplified).
[/list]

[h3]Level bugs:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed collisions on the big bridge in the Forest Beta Co-op;
[*] Fixed the lights on the Tropical Genthru Co-op level;
[*] Changed the challenge in the Dino Dracohorns Co-op;
[*] Fixed the issue with small dinos not respawning in Dino Shieldon Versus;
[*] Fixed collisions in World Selection and in the Dino Level Selection.
[/list]

Thank you for all of your suggestions so far. We’d love to hear your thoughts on [i]Lumberhill[/i] in our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/976900/discussions/]Steam Discussions[/url] and on our Discord server. You can also contact us at [b]lumberhill.support@allingames.com.[/b]

If you enjoy the game, please also consider dropping us a review. They help us a lot!

notes.title: Timmbeerrrr! A release date is coming!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33894005/fe641c091ae7ee36f4d9eb1b77e81e0ccc57077f.jpg[/img]

[h3]Hey-ho Lumberjacks!
[/h3]
You’d better have a flannel shirt at hand—prepare to go into the woods to face absolute chaos solo or with your friends on June 13. Lumberhill’s being released during the PC Gaming Show!

Watch a new trailer here:

[previewyoutube=YH49pqZ-lJs;full][/previewyoutube]

Publisher All in! Games and developer 2BIGo, supported by ARP Games, present Lumberhill, a crazy multiplayer party game where lumberjacks try to get their tasks done while nature fights them every step of the way. Play in co-op, PvP, or solo mode!

[b]In [i]Lumberhill[/i] you will:
[/b][list]
[*] Put your teamwork skills to the test with up to 3 additional friends in local or online co-op or PvP, or play alone in solo mode
[*] Have your butt kicked by nature
[*] Complete tasks in a wide variety of challenging, time-limited levels
[*] Deal with chaotic random events such as wildfires, meteor showers, and pirate attacks
[*] Unlock new exciting worlds and a wide variety of skins as you progress
[*] Find unexpected routes and ways of doing things
[*] Throw pandas around and evade dinosaurs
[*] Probably kick your friends off the map by accident a lot (or on purpose—we don’t judge)
[/list]

What are you looking forward to most in the game? Let us know in the comments or on our [url=https://discord.gg/MkHBbSCj]Discord[/url]. Visit Lumberhill’s website [url=http://lumberhill-game.com/]here[/url].
